text:
yana_pm: Planning runtime kernel bump + router header-split in 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. Need API pinning and console read-ahead. Deploy-bot will canary runtime first.

alex_engineer: Which runtime image/tag? Any breaking header changes?

tim_runtime: runtime:v2.3.0-rc4 — kernel batching + header-split. Router will start sending X-RW-Shard instead of X-RW-Route when flag on.

maria_console: Console change is backward compatible but needs header mapping for metrics. I'll ship release-note and feature flag.

sre_oncall: Rolling criteria?

alex_engineer: Canary 5% for 30m -> look at p95 latency, mem, and 5xx. If green, 50% 30m then 100%.

sre_oncall: Put abort thresholds: p95 > 200ms OR 5xx rate > 0.5% OR heap-growth > 20% in 10m.

deploy-bot: @channel starting canary: service=runtime image=redwood/runtime:v2.3.0-rc4 canary=5% duration=30m

alex_engineer: API route pinning plan:
```yaml
routes:
  /generate:
    primary: api-service:v1.9.1
    runtime_pin:
      default: runtime:v2.2.0
      canary: runtime:v2.3.0-rc4 (5%)
```

maria_console: Release note draft:
- Router: header-split -> new header X-RW-Shard (old X-RW-Route still sent during roll)
- Console: mapping added for X-RW-Shard
- Runtime: kernel batching perf improvement (default off, flag-controlled)

sre_oncall: Noted. Add a console feature flag to opt-in mapping before full rollout :+1:

tim_runtime: Enabling flag on router side requires a single config flip; runtime expects shard header present but tolerates old header for 5% canary.

deploy-bot: canary: runtime 5% -> metrics: p95=120ms, 5xx=0.05%, heap stable. canary window end 30m.

sre_oncall: Looks fine. Move to 50% for 30m.

deploy-bot: scaling canary -> 50% duration=30m

sre_oncall: Abort — memory spike on canary 50% nodes, heap +35% over baseline in 8m. Triggering rollback.

alex_engineer: Acknowledged. Which nodes affected?

tim_runtime: Appears GC pause regression in kernel path for specific sequence lengths. We'll rollback to v2.2.0 immediately.

deploy-bot: Initiating rollback: target=runtime:v2.2.0 scope=all. Pinning API runtime default back to runtime:v2.2.0

maria_console: Reverting console mapping flag in prod.

deploy-bot: rollback complete. runtime now at v2.2.0 across fleet.

sre_oncall: Confirming metrics back to baseline, p95=110ms, 5xx=0.02%, heap back to normal.

yana_pm: OK — aborting dependent router flip. We'll re-run after kernel RC stabilizes. Please capture postmortem and add to release notes.

alex_engineer: I'll open the follow-up issue and tag runtime and router owners.

maria_console: I'll hold the console patch behind a FF and mark release-note in product board.

sre_oncall: Postmortem owner: @sre_oncall. Timeline: canary start -> rollback in ~65m.

deploy-bot: Note: deploy artifact logs -> https://logs.internal/redwood/deploy/5150012345/runtime-canary

yana_pm: Thanks all. We'll reconvene tomorrow 09:30 UTC for a coordination check. :coffee:
